verdict.rationale: CloudConvert's API docs say users can pin processing to a specific region, either through region-specific endpoints or a fixed region in account settings. That directly lets a user choose where their data is handled. The S3 import/export feature is user-side storage and is not credited here. Missing for 10: a list of available regions, an explicit data-residency or storage-location guarantee beyond region selection, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: You can use a specific region by using the region-specific endpoints or setting a fixed region in your account settings.
